SMP · first page onto the design standard · 24 Sep 2026 · for sign-off

A unit's Plan page on the standard

Drawn in the running platform on Mobile's plan: today's page, then the same page with the standard applied. Nothing is built yet. The navigation rows at the top are unchanged, as decided.

What changes

  1. The pillar's name is the largest words on the page (22, from 19), with its code beside it in the same typeface, in a quieter colour.
  2. Codes and numbers (MB01, 12,000#, the row numbers, the quarter marks) move from the typewriter face to Source Sans with even-width numbers, so 12,000# no longer reads with gaps in it.
  3. "Key measures" and "Tactics" become headings in normal letters (17, from small capitals at 11), with the count beside them in a quieter colour.
  4. Table headings go to the standard's 11 (from 10.5); cells keep 13 and get the standard spacing: 8 above and below, 16 to the sides.
  5. Corners: cards and tables 10, controls 6. Today there are six different roundings on this page.
  6. Tactic names stay bold; the outcome beside them becomes regular text, so the two bold columns stop competing and the tactic reads first.
  7. Editing: every box and dropdown is 36 tall (today they range from 30 to 36), the Edit button is a standard button, and the pillar's name box matches the heading size.

Needs your word

  1. Sign-off on this look for the Plan page.
  2. The outcome column in regular text rather than bold (point 6).

Two things I noticed and have not changed, because they are wording rather than looks: in edit mode the pillar says "Capability" twice (the tag beside the name and the Kind row under it), and there is a grey line above the pillars ("drag by the handle to reorder…"). Tell me if you want either gone.
